verdict.rationale: Twenty gives users control over deletion and data ownership. Records can be deleted in batches via the REST/GraphQL APIs, and the Metadata API can delete objects and fields. Self-hosting lets organizations own their data end to end, export is available anytime, and email import can be filtered by date range to limit what is retained. However, there is no evidence of configurable retention policies or automated purging, so retention control must be built with API or workflow workarounds. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods/automated purging, documented workspace/account deletion, deletion of AI/chat data, independent corroboration.
